oauth.title: Google or Apple account
oauth.description:
Sign-in cannot complete in the browser — the final redirect goes to `myapp://callback/`, a mobile-app scheme your browser cannot open. The code is in a redirect **header**, not the address bar (the address bar will look unchanged).

**1.** Press **F12** → **Network** tab, and tick **Preserve log** *before* signing in.

**2.** [Click here to sign in]({oauth_url}) and complete Google/Apple login.

**3.** Filter the Network list for `idpresponse`, click that row, and open **Headers → Response Headers**. Copy the `location:` value — it starts with `myapp://callback/?code=`.

**4.** Paste it below. The code is single-use and expires in ~5 minutes, so paste it right away; if it fails, repeat the sign-in for a fresh one.
